rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Tessa Brandt <t.brandt@larkindispatch.com> with subject "Re: Quick quote for a piece on 'AI doomers vs. builders'?". It read: "Hi Tessa, Thanks for thinking of Halcyon Threshold, and congrats on the piece sounding like a good one. I'm not able to give an on-the-record, attributed quote right now — I have an outside-activities review underway on my end that I need to finish first before speaking publicly by name. I'd love to stay in touch for future pieces once that's settled, and happy to point you to others doing interesting work in this space in the meantime if useful. Best, Morgan"
rows.quote: Larkin Dispatch reporter (deadline was tomorrow noon) — declined the attributed quote, left door open for later.

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Corvid Institute <ops@corvidinstitute.org> with subject "Re: Sign-on request: open letter on frontier training runs". It read: "Hi, Thanks for the invitation, and for the work on the letter. I'm not in a position to sign on as a named, published signatory just yet — I have an internal process to finish before attaching my name and Halcyon Threshold to public materials. I'd like to stay on your list for future letters and will follow up if that changes. Best, Morgan"
rows.quote: Corvid Institute open letter sign-on (deadline Wed) — declined for now, same reason.

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Really glad you reached out, and thank you — five hours a week of data work is genuinely useful. Halcyon Threshold is still in the \"figuring out the plan\" stage right now, so I don't want to hand you something half-baked. Give me a short while to firm up a concrete first project (likely something evals- or landscape-mapping related), and I'll come back to you with a specific ask. In the meantime, if you have thoughts on what's most neglected in independent AI safety work, I'd genuinely like to hear them. Thanks again, Morgan"
rows.quote: Replied to Priya Raman (offered 5 hrs/week help) — thanked her, said a concrete ask is coming once scope is set.
